name: Hemorrhoids
overview: Scripture reveals that hemorrhoids, referred to as emerods, were a grievous affliction sent by God as a form of judgment, notably upon the Philistines. In Deuteronomy 28:27, God warns that He will smite His people with painful diseases, including emerods, from which healing is impossible by human means. The narrative in 1 Samuel 5 details how the Philistines suffered a deadly destruction and were struck with emerods after capturing the Ark of the Covenant, demonstrating God's sovereign power to discipline and call His people to repentance.
